```{r}
library(fastRhockey)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
df <- load_nhl_pbp(seasons = 2021:2025)
```

```{r}
xg_lookup_table <- df |>
  select(x, y, event_type, secondary_type) |>
  filter(event_type == "SHOT" | event_type == "GOAL") |>
  filter(!is.na(secondary_type)) |>
  filter(secondary_type != "cradle") |>
  mutate(is_goal = ifelse(event_type == "GOAL", 1, 0)) |>
  select(-event_type) |>
  mutate(abs_x = abs(x), abs_y = abs(y)) |>
  mutate(shot_type = case_when(
    secondary_type == "wrist"        ~ 0,
    secondary_type == "slap"         ~ 1,
    secondary_type == "snap"         ~ 2,
    secondary_type == "backhand"     ~ 3,
    secondary_type == "tip-in"       ~ 4,
    secondary_type == "deflected"    ~ 5,
    secondary_type == "wrap-around"  ~ 6,
    secondary_type == "poke"         ~ 7,
    secondary_type == "bat"          ~ 8,
    secondary_type == "between-legs" ~ 9,
  )) |>
  mutate(x_group = floor(abs_x / 10) * 100,
         y_group = floor(abs_y / 4) * 10,
         shot_group = shot_type,
         total_group = x_group + y_group + shot_group) |>
  group_by(total_group, x_group, y_group, shot_group) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            total_goals = sum(is_goal),
            goal_percent = total_goals / n,
            .groups = "drop")

saveRDS(xg_lookup_table, "C:/Users/Tyler/Documents/VT Hockey/VTHockey-master/VTHockey-master/R/xg_lookup_table.rds")

# Recheck sparsity with the bigger pooled dataset
sum(xg_lookup_table$n < 15) / nrow(xg_lookup_table)
```

```{r}
new_table <- readRDS("C:/Users/Tyler/Documents/VT Hockey/VTHockey-master/VTHockey-master/R/xg_lookup_table.rds")

used_codes <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4)  # wrist, slap, snap, backhand, tip-in

relevant_bins <- new_table[new_table$shot_group %in% used_codes, ]

sum(relevant_bins$n < 15) / nrow(relevant_bins)
nrow(relevant_bins)
sum(relevant_bins$n)
```
